technique_name: Describe a use case for artificial intelligence in healthcare.
description: One use case for artificial intelligence in healthcare is AI-assisted diagnoses. AI algorithms can be trained to detect certain health problems by analyzing medical images and data, such as MRI scans and genetic sequencing. This can help speed up the diagnosis process and also provide doctors with more accurate and comprehensive results.
